examples.text: api ca, bhāradvāja, surucitaṃ'y'eva hoti, tañ'ca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā, no ce'pi surucitaṃ hoti, tañ'ca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.
na surusurukārakaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

64403.meaningLit: rule about making a slurping sound

64404.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of surusurukāraka
64404.meaning1: making a slurping sound; making a sucking noise
64404.meaning2: making a hissing sound while eating

examples.text: na surusurukārakaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
tena kho pana samayena aññatarena brāhmaṇena saṅghassa payopānaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti. bhikkhū surusurukārakaṃ khīraṃ pivanti.

64405.meaning1: Section 6 of the monks' rules of conduct

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa etadahosi, lābhā āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa, suladdhalābhā āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa, yassa viññū sabrahmacārī satthu sammukhā anumassa anumassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, tañ'ca satthā abbhanumodati.
alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ, yassa me anabhirati uppannā, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti,

64410.meaning1: it is most fortunate!; it is extremely lucky!; it is incredibly wonderful (for)!
64410.meaningLit: it is a well gained gain

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa etadahosi, lābhā āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa, suladdhalābhā āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa, yassa viññū sabrahmacārī satthu sammukhā anumassa anumassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, tañ'ca satthā abbhanumodati.

64411.grammar: ind, acc sg of suladdha, impers (+dat)
64411.meaning1: it is fortunate!; it is lucky (for)!
64411.construction:
su + √labh > ladh + ta + aṃ
suladdha + aṃ

examples.text: sādhū'ti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā evam'assa vacanīyo, lābhā no, āvuso, suladdhaṃ no, āvuso, ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ samanupassāmā'ti.
alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ, yassa me anabhirati uppannā

evaṃ pariyāyadesite kho, ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññam'aññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ na samanujānissanti na samanumaññissanti na samanumodissanti tesam'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissanti.

64413.meaning1: easily obtained; easy to get; easy to find

examples.text: attānañ'ce piyaṃ jaññā, na naṃ pāpena saṃyuje, na hi taṃ sulabhaṃ hoti, sukhaṃ dukkaṭakārinā.
na so satto sulabharūpo, yo na mātābhūtapubbo, yo na pitābhūtapubbo, yo na bhātā, yo na bhaginī, yo na putto, yo na dhītābhūtapubbā'ti

64414.meaning1: easily gets; obtains without difficulty; receives without effort
64414.meaning2: easily gets; well receives; obtains easily
64414.notes: a rare case of a verb starting with su. see also subhāveti

64416.commentary: (PYt) subhikkhan'ti samiddhabhikkhaṃ. sulabhapiṇḍan'ti sukhena labhapiṇḍaṃ. dvīhi padehi aññam'aññassa kāraṇaṃ dasseti, subhikkhattā sulabhapiṇḍaṃ, sulabhapiṇḍattā subhikkhan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, subhikkhaṃ hoti susassaṃ sulabhapiṇḍaṃ, sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo samayo padhānāya.

na kho pana so, sāriputta, saṃsāro sulabharūpo yo mayā asaṃsaritapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, aññatra suddh'āvāsehi devehi. suddh'āvāse c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, deve saṃsareyyaṃ, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punarāgaccheyyaṃ.

64422.meaning1: well honoured; highly esteemed; well respected
64422.meaning2: well honoured; highly esteemed; well respected

examples.text: tass'eva tejena ayaṃ vasun'dharā, āyāgaseṭṭhehi mahī alaṅ'katā, evaṃ imaṃ cakkhumato sarīraṃ, susakkataṃ sakkatasakkatehi.
susaṅkhataṃ bhojanaṃ yā dadāti, suciṃ paṇītaṃ rasasā upetaṃ, sā dakkhiṇā ujjugatesu dinnā, caraṇ'ūpapannesu mahaggatesu, puññena puññaṃ saṃsandamānā, mahapphalā lokavidūna vaṇṇitā.

64424.commentary: (DNa) susaṅgahit'āssa hontī'ti susaṅgahitā assa honti. detu vā mā vā detu, karotu vā mā vā karotu, susaṅgahitā'va honti, na bhijjanti. yadāssa dātabbaṃ hoti, tadā deti. idāni maññe n'atthi, tena na deti. kiṃ mayaṃ dadamānam'eva upaṭṭhahāma? adentaṃ akarontaṃ na upaṭṭhahāmā'ti evaṃ cintenti.

examples.text: bhavati parijan'assavo vidheyyo, mah'imaṃ āvasito susaṅgahito, piyavadū hitasukhataṃ jigīsamāno, abhirucitāni guṇāni ācarati.

64426.meaning1: fact of being well held together
64426.construction:
su + saṃ + √gah + ita + tta
susaṅgahita + tta

64427.meaning1: with cohesive retinue; with united following

examples.text: susaṅgahitaparijano hoti, susaṅgahit'āssa honti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamajānapadā gaṇakamah'āmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā amaccā pārisajjā rājāno bhogiyā kumārā.
sakalaṃ lumbinīvanaṃ cittalatāvanasadisaṃ, mah'ānubhāvassa rañño susajjitaṃ āpānamaṇḍalaṃ viya ahosi.
ayaṃ varāko kiñ'c'āpi idāni sukhito susajjito bhoge paribhuñjati, atha kho tīsu dvāresu ekenā'pi katassa kalyāṇakammassa abhāvā idāni apāyesu anappakaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedissatī'ti.
na vaṇṇarūpena naro sujāno, na vissase ittaradassanena, susaññatānañ'hi viyañjanena, asaññatā lokam'imaṃ caranti.

64431.meaning2: having a good design, well featured
64431.commentary: (KHPa) susaṇṭhānā'ti suṭṭhu saṇṭhānatā, samacitavaṭṭitayuttaṭṭhānesu aṅgapaccaṅgānaṃ samacitavaṭṭitabhāvena sanniveso'ti vuttaṃ hoti. sā'pi etena labbhati.

examples.text: idaṃ pupphaṃ idāni vaṇṇena'pi suvaṇṇaṃ, gandhena'pi sugandhaṃ, saṇṭhānena'pi susaṇṭhānaṃ. khippam'eva dubbaṇṇaṃ, duggandhaṃ, dussaṇṭhānaṃ, aniccataṃ pāpunissati.

64432.meaning1: well established; well settled; firmly fixed (in)

examples.text: tasmā't'iha te, bhikkhu evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, ajjhattaṃ me cittaṃ ṭhitaṃ bhavissati susaṇṭhitaṃ, na ca uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassantī'ti. evañ'hi te, bhikkhu, sikkhitabbaṃ.
cakkhunā kho pan'eva rūpaṃ disvā amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti appatiṭṭhitacitto adīnamānaso abyāpannacetaso. tassa ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
subhujo susu susaṇṭhito sujāto, mudutalun'aṅguliy'assa honti, dīghā tībhi purisavar'aggalakkhaṇehi, cirayapanāya kumāram'ādisanti.

64434.meaning1: well formed; nicely shaped; of good appearance

examples.text: subhujo susu susaṇṭhito sujāto, mudutalun'aṅguliy'assa honti, dīghā tībhi purisavar'aggalakkhaṇehi, cirayapanāya kumāram'ādisanti.
api ca, bhāradvāja, susaddahitaṃ'y'eva hoti, tañ'ca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā, no ce'pi susaddahitaṃ hoti, tañ'ca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.

64436.meaning1: easy to please (regarding); easy to satisfy (with)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'aṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu, app'āhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto

64437.meaning2: well tied up; well fastened together
64437.commentary: (DNa) susannaddho'ti subaddho. (DNt) susannaddho'ti sukhena gahetvā gamanayogyatāvasena suṭṭhu sajjito. taṃ pana susajjanaṃ suṭṭhu bandhanavasenevā'ti āha subaddho'ti.

examples.text: ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūr'ābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me tvaṃ pajānāhī'ti. atha kho so sahāyako sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍetvā sāṇasuttabhāraṃ ādiyi.

64438.meaning1: well mentally balanced; perfectly even-minded; highly equanimous

examples.text: dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi

64439.commentary: (VINa) samaṇena bhavitabbaṃ abyāvaṭena, samaṇo assa susamaṇo'ti samaṇena nāma īdisesu kammesu abyāvaṭena abyāpārena bhavitabbaṃ, evaṃ bhavanto hi samaṇo susamaṇo assā'ti, evaṃ naṃ apasādetvā gaccha tvaṃ na mayaṃ taṃ jānāmā'ti āhaṃsu.

64440.meaning1: correctly adopted; properly undertaken; (comm) well grasped
64440.notes: see BHS samātta for discussion. PED takes as saṃ √ap

examples.text: evam'ass'āyaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo susamatto samādinno, ubhay'aṃsaṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati, riñcati akusalaṃ ṭhānaṃ.

64441.meaning1: correctly completed; well finished; perfectly done

examples.text: mūla-susaṃvara-dhammadāy'ādā, bherav'ānaṅgaṇ'ākaṅkheyya-vatthaṃ, sallekha-sammādiṭṭhi-satipaṭṭhaṃ, vaggavaro asamo susamatto.

64442.meaning1: well investigated; well inspected; thoroughly scrutinized; fully examined
64442.construction: su + saṃ + anu > ann + √es > is + ta
64442.commentary: (MNa) dhammatāsusamanniṭṭho'ti dhammatāya susamanniṭṭho, sabhāven'eva suṭṭhu samannesito hotī'ti attho. (MNa) dhammatā susamanniṭṭhā hotī'ti sabhāvo suṭṭhu samannesito hoti.

examples.text: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tathāgate dhammasamannesanā hoti. evañ'ca pana tathāgato dhammatāsusamanniṭṭho hotī'ti.

evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgatassa kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa dhammatā susamanniṭṭhā hoti sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya. evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sot'āpattiphala-samannāgato hotī'ti.

64443.construction: su + saṃ + anu > ann + √es > is + ta

64444.meaning1: resolutely undertaken; fully engaged with; energetically taken up; (comm) firmly held up

examples.text: yesañ'ca susamāraddhā, niccaṃ kāyagatā sati, akiccaṃ te na sevanti, kicce sātaccakārino, satānaṃ sampajānānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.

daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tasmā't'iha vo, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kāyagatā no sati bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā'ti.

64445.meaning1: (of music) well composed; well put together; well played

examples.text: k'āyaṃ eḷagalāgumbe, karoti ahuhāsiyaṃ, na'y'idha naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā, tāḷaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ, anamhikāle sussoṇi, kiṃ nu jagghasi sobhaṇe.
bahussuto ca medhāvī, sīlesu susamāhito, cetosamatham'anuyutto, api muddhani tiṭṭhatu.
yo ca vantakasāvassa, sīlesu susamāhito, upeto damasaccena, sa ve kāsāvam'arahati.

64447.meaning1: (of mind) completely calm; totally settled; well meditatively composed
64447.commentary: (SNa) susamāhito'ti appanāya'pi upacārena'pi suṭṭhu samāhito. (THa) ajjhattaṃ susamāhito'ti visay'ajjhatte phalasamāpattiyaṃ suṭṭhu samāhito

examples.text: so jhāyī assāsarato, ajjhattaṃ susamāhito, gacchaṃ samāhito nāgo, ṭhito nāgo samāhito.
gattāni parimajjitvā, puna'p'āruyha caṅkamaṃ, caṅkame caṅkamiṃ so'haṃ, ajjhattaṃ susamāhito.

64448.meaning1: completely calm within; thoroughly settled within

examples.text: mānaṃ pahāya susamāhit'atto, sucetaso sabbadhi vippamutto, eko araññe viharaṃ appamatto, sa maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran'ti.

64449.meaning1: with well meditatively composed thoughts; with careful intent
64449.meaning2: with well composed intentions; with carefully composed thoughts

examples.text: appamattā satīmanto, susīlā hotha bhikkhavo, susamāhitasaṅkappā, sacittam'anurakkhatha.

64450.meaning1: completely cut off; totally uprooted; thoroughly eradicated; utterly destroyed

examples.text: yassa cittaṃ namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, evam'ass'āyaṃ paṭhamo cetasovinibandho susamucchinno hoti.

64451.meaning1: easy to arouse; easy to stimulate
64451.meaningLit: easy to cause to stand up together

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.

64452.meaning1: completely removed; totally eradicated; thoroughly annihilated

examples.text: kathaṃ jānato pan'āyasmato, kathaṃ passato imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṃkāramamaṃkāramān'ānusayā susamūhatā'ti?
atimāno ca omāno, pahīnā susamūhatā, asmimāno samucchinno, sabbe mānavidhā hatā'ti.

64453.meaning1: fact of being completely removed; fact of (something) being totally eradicated
64453.construction:
su + saṃ + ud + √han + ta + tta
susamūhata + tta
64453.commentary: (PMa) susamūhatattā'ti vikkhambhana-tadaṅgasamuccheda-vasena suṭṭhu samūhatattā nāsitattā. potthakesu pana susamugghātattā'ti likhanti, taṃ na sundaraṃ.

examples.text: so kāyaduṭṭhullassa'pi suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassa'pi susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassa'pi suppaṭivinītattā na andh'andhaṃ viya jhāyati. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parisuddh'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

susamāraddhā'ti cattāro susamāraddhā, tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anativattan'aṭṭhena susamāraddhā, indriyānaṃ ekaras'aṭṭhena susamāraddhā, tadupaga-vīriya-vāhan'aṭṭhena susamāraddhā, tappaccanīkānaṃ kilesānaṃ susamūhatattā susamāraddhā.
ariṭṭho upariṭṭho tagarasikhī yasassī, sudassano piyadassī ca susambuddho, gandhāro piṇḍolo upāsabho ca, nīto tatho sutavā bhāvit'atto.

64455.meaning1: easily realized; easily comprehended; easily understood (by)

examples.text: bhavarāgaparetehi, bhavasot'ānusāribhi, māradheyy'ānupannehi, n'āyaṃ dhammo susambudho.
kicchena me adhigataṃ, h'alaṃ dāni pakāsituṃ, rāgadosaparetehi, n'āyaṃ dhammo susambudho.
tass'āyasmato vihāro abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko, majjhegabbho, samantāpariyāgāro, supaññattaṃ mañcapīṭhaṃ bhisibimbohanaṃ, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ supaṭṭhitaṃ, pariveṇaṃ susammaṭṭhaṃ.

64457.meaning1: totally muddled; completely confused; thoroughly forgotten

examples.text: yesaṃ dhammā susammuṭṭhā, paravādesu nīyare, suttā te nappabujjhanti, kālo tesaṃ pabujjhitun'ti.

64459.meaning1: with well toned body; in shape

examples.text: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo aparena samayena susallikhitagatto pāṇinā gattāni anumajjanto tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, subhikkhaṃ hoti susassaṃ sulabhapiṇḍaṃ, sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo samayo padhānāya.

64461.meaning1: very consistent; extremely coherent; well connected

examples.text: akkosabhaṇḍanavihesakāriṃ, ubbādhikaṃ bahujanappamaddanaṃ, abāḷhaṃ giraṃ so na bhaṇi pharusaṃ, madhuraṃ bhaṇi susahitaṃ sakhilaṃ.

64463.meaning1: well organized; carefully ordered; neatly arranged; well taken care of

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
kiṃ nu kho me ayyā santaṃ'y'eva nu kho ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti udāhu asantaṃ udāhu mayham'ev'ete kamm'antā susaṃvihitā yena me ayyā santaṃ'y'eva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti, no asantaṃ?

64464.meaning1: well organized in work; capable in business

examples.text: susaṃvihitakamm'antā, saṅgahitaparijjanā, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.

kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo ye te bhattu abbhantarā kamm'antā, uṇṇā'ti vā kappāsā'ti vā, tattha dakkhā hoti analasā tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgatā alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.

64465.meaning1: well restrained; well controlled; well guarded (in)
64465.commentary: (VINa) susaṃvuto'ti hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā akīḷāpento, suvinīto'ti attho.

examples.text: asubh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu susaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi ca mattaññuṃ, saddhaṃ āraddhavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve nappasahati māro, vāto selaṃ'va pabbataṃ.
vāc'ānurakkhī manasā susaṃvuto, kāyena ca n'ākusalaṃ kayirā, ete tayo kammapathe visodhaye, ārādhaye maggam'isippaveditaṃ.

64466.meaning1: thoroughly self-restrained; completely self-controlled; well self-composed

examples.text: susaṃvut'atto visikh'antare caraṃ, kulesu kāmesu asaṅgamānaso, cando yathā dosinapuṇṇamāsiyā, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

64467.meaning1: thorough self-restraint; complete self-control; total self-composure

examples.text: tapojigucchāya susaṃvut'atto, vācaṃ pahāya kalahaṃ janena, samosavajjā virato saccavādī, na hi nūna tādisaṃ karoti pāpan'ti.
akkosabhaṇḍanavihesakāriṃ, ubbādhikaṃ bahujanappamaddanaṃ, abāḷhaṃ giraṃ so na bhaṇi pharusaṃ, madhuraṃ bhaṇi susaṃhitaṃ sakhilaṃ.

64470.meaning1: burial ground for bones of cremated corpses; cemetery

examples.text: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanappatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
bhikkhuno vijigucchato, bhajato rittam'āsanaṃ, rukkhamūlaṃ susānaṃ vā, pabbatānaṃ guhāsu vā.
sārambhaṃ nāma… pubb'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, apar'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, abbhāghātanissitaṃ vā hoti, āghātananissitaṃ vā hoti, susānanissitaṃ vā hoti, uyyānanissitaṃ vā hoti

64474.meaning1: which increase the cemeteries; which grows the burial grounds

examples.text: kiṃ te idha sārasammataṃ, kuṇapapūramhi susānavaḍḍhane, bhedanadhamme kaḷevare, yaṃ disvā vimano udikkhasi.

te'pi sakkānubhāvena tassā guṇaṃ anussaritvā kahaṃ no mātā'ti antogāme manusse pucchitvā susān'ābhimukhaṃ gatā'ti sutvā amma, ammā'ti susānamaggaṃ paṭipajjitvā taṃ disvā'va pādesu patitvā amma, amhākaṃ dosaṃ khamāhī'ti taṃ khamāpesuṃ. sā'pi nattāraṃ gaṇhi.
ye, bhikkhave, sattā sāy'anhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, susāyanho, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānan'ti.
bāhusaccañ'ca sippañ'ca, vinayo ca susikkhito, subhāsitā ca yā vācā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cattāro daḷhadhammā dhanuggahā susikkhitā katahatthā kat'ūpāsanā catuddisā ṭhitā assu.

64480.commentary: (THa) ete matthake uṭṭhitāhi sundarāhi sikhāhi samannāgatattā susikhā

examples.text: sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.
atha kho susimo devaputto āyasmato sāriputtassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne mahatiyā devaputtaparisāya parivuto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

64482.meaning1: name of a monk, former wandering ascetic

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho susimo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, icchām'ahaṃ, āvuso ānanda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritun'ti.

lahukena asanenā'ti anto susiraṃ katvā tūl'ādīhi pūretvā katalakkhaparikammena sallahukakaṇḍena. evaṃ katañ'hi ekausabhagāmī dve usabhāni'pi gacchati… aṭṭh'usabhagāmī soḷasa usabhāni'pi gacchati. appakasirenā'ti niddukkhena.
anuṭṭhahaṃ avāyāmaṃ, sukhaṃ yatr'ādhigacchati, susīma tattha gacchāhi, mañ'ca tatth'eva pāpayāti.

64490.meaning1: name of a monk, former wandering ascetic

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena susīmo paribbājako rājagahe paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ.
appamattā satīmanto, susīlā hotha bhikkhavo, susamāhitasaṅkappā, sacittam'anurakkhatha.
visenibhūto upasantacitto, nāgo'va danto carati anejo, bhikkhu susīlo suvimuttacitto, so ty'āhutiṃ bhuñjatu aggapiṇḍaṃ.

64496.meaning1: good morality; good ethics; excellent morals; principled behaviour

examples.text: iti pubb'eva kho pan'assa susīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, dussīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ, ayañ'ca micchādiṭṭhi micchāsaṅkappo micchāvācā ariyānaṃ paccanīkatā asaddhammasaññatti attukkaṃsanā paravambhanā.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu daharo hoti yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo samayo padhānāya.
daharo tvaṃ bhikkhu, pabbajito susu kāḷakeso, bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato, paṭhamena vayasā, anikkīḷitāvī kāmesu.
daharā tvaṃ rūpavatī, ahañ'ca daharo susu, pañc'aṅgikena turiyena, eh'ayye'bhiramāmase'ti.
ahi āviñcheyya vammikaṃ pavekkhāmī'ti, susumāro āviñcheyya udakaṃ pavekkhāmī'ti, pakkhī āviñcheyya ākāsaṃ ḍessāmī'ti
cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, bhayāni udak'orohantassa pāṭikaṅkhitabbāni. katamāni cattāri? ūmibhayaṃ, kumbhīlabhayaṃ, āvaṭṭabhayaṃ, susukābhayaṃ
